title: Product quantities and logistics context (proposed enrichment bundle)
practical_value: User product/order/inventory lines → declared portable GTIN or evidenced manufacturer-part bridge → classification and compatible quantity units → shipment/location context. Ask whether reorder quantities or shipping exposure differ by class and transport location. Need item metadata/assignment rights, SKU→portable key bridge, unit qualifiers and transport crosswalk. No global open GTIN directory presumed.
showcase_value: Unit-aware inventory chart and transport-location map; no unit conversion until reconciliation.
reason: All dependencies are research concepts; suitable dataset/recordset, identifier reconciliation, licensing and measured join dependencies remain open. Not selected, implemented or validated.
